The website branch contains no standalone LICENSE/SPDX license. Its README section “Reusing this for another project” and docs/project-page/adoption.md explicitly describe reuse by other research teams. Those original permission/adoption documents are preserved alongside the exact source files. This is the basis for adapting the carousel; no MIT/Apache license is asserted or inherited from the unrelated model-code branch.

Adapted files: ../../modules/demo-deck.js and ../../modules/demo-deck.css. Changes: buildless ES-module API; external player ownership; keyboard navigation; inactive-content focus management; touch direction locking; reduced motion; cleanup; resize handling; WE-Dream presentation. Original research text, videos, figures, branding and analytics are not used by the adapted carousel.
